#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

int n, m;
double p[20], res[1 << 20], q[20];

int main() {
    cin >> n >> m;

        cin >> p[i];
        res[1 << i] = p[i];
        q[i] = 0;
    }
    for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
        vector<int> selected, unselected;
        double sum_unselected = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if ((mask >> j) & 1) {
                selected.push_back(j);
            } else {
                unselected.push_back(j);
                sum_unselected += p[j];
            }
        }
        if ((int)selected.size() == m || ((int)selected.size() < m && sum_unselected < 1e-5)) {
            for (auto x : selected) q[x] += res[mask];
        } else if ((int)selected.size() < m) {
            for (auto x : unselected) {
                res[mask | (1 << x)] += res[mask] * p[x] / sum_unselected;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cout << fixed << setprecision(15) << q[i] << " ";
    }
    cout << "\n";
    return 0;
}
